report.heading: SEO audit
report.data_note: All figures come from the Google Search Console API for the property {site}.
report.footer: Generated from Google Search Console data. Figures reflect what Google recorded for this property in the selected period.

diagnosis.disappeared: The page no longer appears in search results
diagnosis.ctr_collapse: Same impressions and position, far fewer clicks: the snippet stopped working
diagnosis.fewer_impressions: Fewer impressions at the same position: lower demand, or the page ranks for fewer queries

executive.heading: Executive summary
executive.brand_share: {pct}% of all clicks come from brand queries and {non_brand_pct}% from non-brand queries.
executive.uplift: If the top {n} page-two queries reached position 3, they would bring an estimated +{clicks} clicks over a period like this one. An order of magnitude, not a forecast.
executive.quick_win_count: {n} quick wins are ready to start.
executive.brand_share_anonymized: {pct}% of all clicks come from brand queries, {non_brand_pct}% from non-brand queries, and {anonymized_pct}% from queries Google does not disclose.
executive.brand_share_top: Among the top {n} queries, {pct}% of clicks are brand and {non_brand_pct}% non-brand.
executive.uplift_one: If the top page-two query reached position 3, it would bring an estimated +{clicks} clicks over a period like this one. An order of magnitude, not a forecast.

paginated_pages.title: {n} deep listing pages earn search traffic
paginated_pages.title_one: One deep listing page earns search traffic
paginated_pages.description: Page 2 and later of a listing collect {clicks} clicks. Google indexes paginated pages on purpose; the point is that a deep page is answering queries the first page, or a dedicated page, should be answering.
paginated_pages.description_one: Page 2 or later of a listing collects {clicks} clicks. Google indexes paginated pages on purpose; the point is that a deep page is answering queries the first page, or a dedicated page, should be answering.
strategy: Keep a self-referencing canonical on every paginated page: pointing them all at page one hides the items they list
Look at which queries land on the deep pages and whether a category, filter or guide page should own them
Link the products or articles that attract those queries from the first page or from a dedicated page
Give paginated pages plain, distinct titles ("Page 2") so they do not compete with page one

http_pages.title: The HTTP version is still indexed
http_pages.description: {n} HTTP pages collected {clicks} clicks in the period. HTTP and HTTPS coexisting in the index splits ranking signals and creates duplicate content.
http_pages.description_one: One HTTP page collected {clicks} clicks in the period. HTTP and HTTPS coexisting in the index splits ranking signals and creates duplicate content.
strategy: Configure a permanent 301 redirect from http:// to https:// at the server or CDN level
Enable HSTS with a max-age of at least one year
Update the XML sitemap to HTTPS URLs only and resubmit it
Verify with curl -I that every HTTP URL answers 301, not 302
Request reindexing of the HTTPS versions through URL Inspection

mixed_hosts.title: Multiple hostnames are indexed
mixed_hosts.description: {n} different hostnames generate traffic: {hosts}. Without one canonical version, links and authority signals are spread across them.
strategy: Pick one canonical hostname and 301 redirect all others to it
Point every page's canonical tag at the chosen hostname
Update internal links to use the canonical hostname
Confirm the canonical property in Search Console and request reindexing

low_ctr_queries.title: {n} first-page queries earn far fewer clicks than their position
low_ctr_queries.title_one: One first-page query earns far fewer clicks than its position
low_ctr_queries.description: These queries rank in the top 10 but earn less than 60% of the CTR their position normally gets: about {lost} clicks are left on the table. The ranking is there; the snippet is not converting.
strategy: Rewrite the title tag around the differentiator that matters to this audience
Rewrite the meta description with a clear call to action, under 155 characters
Add the structured data the page type supports so the snippet can carry more
Test title variants that signal freshness where the topic warrants it
Avoid generic "Category | Brand" titles in favour of benefit-led phrasing
Track CTR weekly after each change and iterate
low_ctr_queries.description_one: This query ranks in the top 10 but earns less than 60% of the CTR its position normally gets: about {lost} clicks are left on the table. The ranking is there; the snippet is not converting.

page_two_queries.title: {n} queries sit in positions 11-20 with real volume
page_two_queries.title_one: One query sits in positions 11-20 with real volume
page_two_queries.description: Queries on page two of Google. A focused push can move them into the top 10, where almost all of the clicks are.
strategy: Identify which page Google ranks for each of these queries
Fill the content gaps on that page: specifications, comparisons, FAQs
Add internal links from the site's strongest pages to the target page
Read the current top 10 and close the gap that keeps them ahead
Check the keyword appears in the H1, an H2, the URL and the first paragraph
Consider digital PR where the competition is driven by authority

weak_high_visibility_pages.title: {n} high-visibility pages earn far fewer clicks than their position
weak_high_visibility_pages.title_one: One high-visibility page earns far fewer clicks than its position
weak_high_visibility_pages.description: Pages with many first-page impressions and less than 60% of the expected CTR: about {lost} clicks are left on the table. Either the snippet does not match the intent behind the queries, or rich results above it take the clicks.
strategy: Review title and meta description page by page
Check that the content above the fold answers the search intent
Review Core Web Vitals: a slow LCP costs mobile clicks
Check whether the page competes with another page of the site for the same query
Add the structured data that fits the page type
weak_high_visibility_pages.description_one: A page with many first-page impressions and less than 60% of the expected CTR: about {lost} clicks are left on the table. Either the snippet does not match the intent behind the queries, or rich results above it take the clicks.

sitemap_problems.title: {n} sitemaps report problems
sitemap_problems.description: Search Console flagged problems in the submitted sitemaps: unreachable URLs, redirects inside the sitemap, noindex pages, or non-canonical URLs. Warnings: {warnings}. Errors: {errors}.
strategy: Open each sitemap in Search Console to read the detail behind the counts
Remove URLs that redirect, 404 or carry noindex
Keep only HTTPS, canonical, parameter-free URLs in the sitemap
Split sitemaps above 50MB or 50,000 URLs into a sitemap index
Resubmit the cleaned sitemap
Automate sitemap generation from the CMS so it cannot drift again

indexing_problems.title: {n} inspected pages are not indexed as they should be
indexing_problems.title_one: One inspected page is not indexed as it should be
indexing_problems.description: The pages that lost the most clicks, and then the top pages, were run through URL Inspection. These are not in an indexed state. Some exclusions are deliberate (noindex, alternate pages): check each one against its coverage state.
strategy: Open URL Inspection for each page to read the exact coverage state
"Duplicate, Google chose different canonical": check the declared canonical and whether the content is genuinely unique
"Crawled - currently not indexed": the content is not earning its place; improve depth and originality
"Discovered - currently not indexed": a crawl budget problem; reduce the number of low-value URLs
Request indexing after each fix
Recheck weekly for the first two to three weeks

traffic_drop.title: Clicks fell {pct}% against {baseline}
traffic_drop.description: Clicks went from {previous} to {current}. Impressions changed by {impressions_pct}%. This needs investigating before anything else on this list.
strategy: Compare the top 20 queries and pages across both periods to isolate where the loss happened
Check whether a Google core update landed on those dates
Review recent site changes: deploys, redirects, removed pages, template changes
Check server logs for 5xx errors or blocked crawler access
Check Search Console for manual actions and security issues
Where the loss is concentrated on specific keywords, look at what the results that overtook you changed

rewrite_snippets.title: Rewrite titles and meta descriptions on high-visibility pages
rewrite_snippets.action: Start with {url} ({impressions} impressions, CTR {ctr} against an expected {expected_ctr}). Estimated uplift: +{uplift} clicks.

push_page_two.title: Push the page-two queries into the top 10
push_page_two.action: Start with "{query}" ({impressions} impressions, position {position}). Fill the content gaps on the target page, add internal links and structured data.

fix_cannibalization.title: Resolve cannibalisation between pages
fix_cannibalization.action: "{query}" is split across {pages} pages and none of them holds it firmly. Choose the page that should answer it, merge or differentiate the others, and point internal links at the chosen one.

force_https.title: Force HTTPS everywhere with 301 redirects
force_https.action: Configure the 301 from HTTP to HTTPS at the server level, enable HSTS, update the sitemap and resubmit it.

answer_questions.title: Target featured snippets and People Also Ask
answer_questions.action: {n} question queries already rank in the top 15. Answer each one directly near the top of the target page, in 40-60 words, under a heading that repeats the question.
answer_questions.action_one: One question query already ranks in the top 15. Answer it directly near the top of the target page, in 40-60 words, under a heading that repeats the question.

reduce_brand_dependency.title: Reduce the dependency on brand traffic
reduce_brand_dependency.action: {pct}% of clicks come from brand queries. Invest in top-of-funnel informational content to widen the audience.

build_topic_hub.title: Build a content hub around "{theme}"
build_topic_hub.action: "{theme}" concentrates {clicks} clicks across {queries} queries. Create a pillar page and a cluster of supporting content.

review_pagination.title: Find out why deep listing pages rank
review_pagination.action: Check which queries land on page 2 and later, and give the strongest ones a page of their own or a link from page one. Keep each paginated page's own canonical.

roadmap.nothing_critical: No critical work outstanding: move straight to the medium-term optimisations
roadmap.optimize_page_two: Optimise {n} target pages for the queries in positions 11-20
roadmap.fix_cannibalization: Resolve cannibalisation on the {n} highest-value queries
roadmap.content_hubs: Build content hubs around the main themes: {themes}
roadmap.expand_non_brand: Widen the funnel with informational content to grow non-brand traffic
roadmap.localize: Evaluate localisation for the emerging markets: {countries}
roadmap.backlinks: {n} queries are stuck on page two: review the backlink profile and plan digital PR for the pages they land on
roadmap.competitors: Clicks are down: compare the results that now outrank the site on the lost queries
roadmap.monitor: Re-run this report in 30 days to measure the effect of the work above
roadmap.optimize_page_two_one: Optimise the target page for the query in positions 11-20
roadmap.fix_cannibalization_one: Resolve the cannibalisation on the most valuable query
roadmap.backlinks_one: One query is stuck on page two: review the backlink profile and plan digital PR for the page it lands on

device.has_gap: Mobile and desktop rank differently enough to be worth investigating

skipped.heading: Some sections could not be checked
skipped.sitemaps: Sitemaps were not checked: the Search Console API call failed. An empty sitemap section does not mean there are no sitemap problems.
skipped.content_decay: The month-by-month page history could not be fetched in full: content decay was not checked.
skipped.indexing: URL Inspection failed for some pages: those pages were not checked and are not counted as indexing problems.
skipped.brand: Brand and non-brand totals could not be fetched over every query: the split shown is computed on the top queries only.

empty.no_issues: No issues matched the thresholds for this property and period.
empty.no_rows: No data for this section in the selected period.
empty.no_opportunities: No opportunities above the thresholds in this period.

truncated.pages: The site has more pages than the {n} read for this report: pages below that cut are not listed as lost.

method.thresholds: Thresholds computed on this property: a query counts from {q_impr} impressions, a page from {p_impr}; high visibility starts at {q_high} impressions for a query and {p_high} for a page.
method.ctr_gap: A result is below its expected CTR when it earns less than 60% of what its position normally earns. The curve used:
method.brand_guess: Brand terms guessed from the domain ({terms}): pass the real ones for a reliable split.
method.decay: Steady decline: clicks fell in each of the last three complete months.
method.comparison_previous: Period {from} – {to}, compared with the previous period of the same length: {prev_from} – {prev_to}.
method.comparison_year: Period {from} – {to}, compared with the same period last year: {prev_from} – {prev_to}.
